stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_danish_anat: Danish anatomist and bishop. Proposed law of superposition (1669). Later beatified by Catholic Church (2002).
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_scottish_fa: Scottish farmer-physician-geologist. Father of modern geology. Founded uniformitarianism. Siccar Point unconformity his outdoor classroom.
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_british_fos: British fossil hunter, Lyme Regis. Found first ichthyosaur, plesiosaur, and pterosaur. Working class woman; excluded from learned societies despite immense contributions.
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_scottish_la: Scottish lawyer-turned-geologist. Principles of Geology was the standard text for decades. Mentor and friend to Darwin.
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_swiss_ameri: Swiss-American naturalist. Proposed ice ages (1837). Founded Harvard Museum of Comparative Zoology. Later opposed Darwin evolution.
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_british_can: British canal surveyor. Produced first geological map of a nation. Realized fossils correlated strata. Imprisoned for debt despite his contributions.
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_german_mete: German meteorologist and polar explorer. Proposed continental drift (1912). Died on Greenland ice cap before vindication.
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_british_geo: British geologist. Pioneered radiometric dating and mantle convection. First accurate age of Earth (1913).
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_american_oc: American oceanographer. With Bruce Heezen, mapped the ocean floor and discovered mid-Atlantic rift. Long uncredited; recognized later in life.
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_princeton_g: Princeton geologist and Navy officer. Proposed seafloor spreading (1962). Discovered Pacific guyots during WWII.
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_canadian_ge: Canadian geophysicist. Defined transform faults (1965), Wilson Cycle, mantle plumes. Triple international acclaim.
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_danish_seis: Danish seismologist. Discovered Earth inner core (1936) from seismic waves. Active in research until age 99.
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_german_amer: German-American seismologist. Mantle-core boundary (Gutenberg discontinuity). Co-author of magnitude scale with Charles Richter.
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_american_se: American seismologist. Created magnitude scale (1935). Caltech.
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_japanese_am: Japanese-American seismologist (Caltech). Introduced moment magnitude scale that supplanted Richter for large quakes.
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_american_se: American seismologist. USGS Southern California science advisor. Public science communicator and advocate for disaster preparedness.
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_usgs_pasade: USGS Pasadena seismologist. Books on the history and sociology of earthquakes.
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_university_: University of Colorado. Himalayan seismic hazard expert. Often comments on India earthquake risk.
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_usgs_paleos: USGS paleoseismologist. Confirmed 1700 Cascadia earthquake by combining ghost-forest dating and Japanese tsunami records.
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_geological_: Geological Survey of Canada. Cascadia and Japan subduction modeler. Slow-slip theorist.
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_french_geol: French geologist. Active tectonics of Asia and Mediterranean.
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_uc_berkeley: UC Berkeley geologist. With father Luis, found iridium spike at K-Pg = asteroid evidence (1980).
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_first_woman: First woman to earn PhD in geology in US (Johns Hopkins, 1893). USGS geologist. Trained generation of women geologists at Bryn Mawr.
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_usgs_field_: USGS field geologist; surveyed Western US copper districts.
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_british_geo: British geologist. Wife and research partner of Charles Lyell. Field notebooks and conchology contributions; long unattributed.
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_american_fo: American fossil collector. Discovered T. rex Sue, the most complete T. rex ever found, now at Field Museum Chicago.
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_carnegie_in: Carnegie Institution. Mineral evolution and origin of life chemistry. Coined mineral evolution: most minerals younger than life.
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_british_kar: British karst geomorphologist. Oxford geographer; queen of karst.
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_african_ame: African American geologist; early Howard University faculty; broke barriers in segregated era.
stem.platetectonics.geo_cont_asian_ameri: Asian-American geographer and geomorphologist. GIS leadership; bridges geo and social science.
